title: Reading spread, self-check
summary: The note on paper at reading quality — 18px in cols 3–8 with its margin in cols 10–12 (the three layer glyphs, Kelwin's definition of revenue entropy, the Gartner source, a 'What to look for' note) — and one drawing where the argument turns: 'One symptom, three causes', a wire labelled “We need more pipeline.” that splits into the three failures, each ending at its layer and the note's own question, with the two answers that question asks for ('It changes' / 'Nothing lands' for the either/or narrative question, Yes / No for the other two).

reference.site: Approved Kelwin letter/S (a reading column with a margin on the 12-column grid) and evidence/T (a sourced figure); Tailscale's blog article for the long-form measure
reference.borrowed: A long-form reading column at a real measure with its apparatus beside it rather than inside it (sidenotes in a margin, one wide figure that breaks the column once).
reference.kelwin: Paper as the page's one document moment; the column in cols 3–8 and the margin in cols 10–12 of the real 12-column grid; Mona at 18px; the nav's capability glyphs as the layer key; 15px Mona 'What to look for' notes instead of mono 'Field reading' panels; the figure drawn in the kit's 1px language with one red element and no 'Fig.' caption.

motion: entrance (play-once, at 40% visible): the symptom rises, its trunk draws to the fork, the fork lands, the three branches plot one after another, the three failure rows rise, the reading block fades in (≈2.8s). From 1280 down the figure stacks and the branches give way to the left trunk and stubs.

interaction: two answers per question (aria-pressed): 'It changes' / 'Nothing lands' for the narrative question, Yes / No for signal and memory. The answer that points to a failure ('Nothing lands', 'No', 'No'; data-v="fail") lights that branch, that layer's glyph and its square in ink; 'Where to look first' names the lit layers (aria-live polite, atomic). A second press clears an answer. Nothing is stored or sent.

on the live site: the slot plays the reading as it scrolls in; the figure waits for 40% of itself to be visible (its own IntersectionObserver). Reduced motion: final state at once, toggles still work.
story: The argument itself: the symptom founders name, the condition underneath it (defined here, once), the three failures that share it, why more activity makes it worse, and how to tell them apart. The drawing sits where the note turns from explaining to diagnosing, so the reader answers the three questions about their own company before the closing line.

phone: ≥1280: the horizontal drawing; its trunk is fluid (5 × (col + gutter) − 72px) and the 72px fork always ends where the failure rows start, and the three rows share one subgrid so the answer controls form one column. ≤1279: the drawing stacks — the symptom on top, then one ink trunk down the left of the three failure rows with a stub into each (≤3 strokes per bundle), the answers in their own column right of the questions, the reading block last. ≤1023: the column takes cols 1–8 and the margin cols 9–12; the layer key stacks one layer per row (glyph + name); the answers drop under each question. ≤767: one column; every margin note falls in after its paragraph, the layer key leads the note; 17px reading type, 26px subheads; the answer buttons run at .12em tracking and 10px padding so 'It changes / Nothing lands' fits at 320.
notes: A reading surface: ≈2,500px tall at 1440, over the 1400px cap by design (the whole note). Margin notes hang from their paragraph's row (negative bottom margin) so they never push the column; the definition note is offset below the layer key; 'What to look for' sits in its subsection heading's row (row 6), tops aligned, so it ends before the next heading at every width. Source links wrap only before their last word, so '· year ↗' never strands. FOUNDER CHOICE (placement): the drawing sits under 'Reading the difference', right after the paragraph that asks the three questions, rather than under 'Three failures, one symptom' as the map reads — there the self-check would ask the questions before the text introduces them; here the reader meets the [K] questions twice in a row (once read, once answered). The sub-line no longer restates them. If the founder prefers the map's placement, the figure moves up unchanged. Red: the figure label's square only; lit layers are ink, so several failures never make several reds.
